subject: Question about wireless headphones at your Nanshan store
body: Hi, I'm planning to come by your Shenzhen Nanshan store this weekend to look at wireless headphones. I mostly listen to music on my commute and take a lot of calls, so battery life and call quality matter more to me than fancy features. I wanted to ask whether you usually have a few models out that I can actually try on and listen to, or if it's mostly boxed stock. Also curious if weekends tend to be busy, since I'd rather come when I can take my time. Thanks.
